## 2. Columns the pipeline reads

Team = team-model feature code (rolling stats, ELO, availability); Impact = player impact code, which feeds the team model's slot / availability / impact features; Prod features = how many of the production team model's 252 features are built directly from the column (rolling L5/L10, HOME/AWAY/DIFF); Player = player projection model; Serving = nightly prediction code; Site = public API. Fill = share of rows with a value, prior 60 days -> last 14 days.

Production team model: 252 features. 168 are rolling box-score stats traced to one column below; the other 84 are built from several inputs (ELO and win % / streak from `game_list` results; rest and schedule from `game_list` dates; slot / availability / impact from player impact plus the official injury report).
